points.description: States that selection sort finds the minimum (smallest) value among the remaining, unsorted elements. Equivalent wording such as 'the smallest of the rest' or 'the lowest value not yet placed' earns the mark.

States that this minimum is swapped with the current element, and that the process moves through the array from left to right, one element at a time. Equivalent wording such as 'exchanged with the element at the current position' or 'working from the start of the array onward' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks (5) for an answer that says selection sort finds the minimum of the remaining unsorted elements and swaps it into the current position, working left to right. Award P1 for the minimum-of-remaining idea and P2 for the swap into the current position with left-to-right progression. Answers that describe only the swap, or only the minimum search, earn the matching point alone; answers that describe a different algorithm (e.g. finding the maximum with no swap logic, or insertion-style shifting) earn no marks for the affected point.
